name: Classic French Onion Soup (Broth & Bread Hack)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder · Triton's / Disney Magic · Lumiere's
whyItWorks: Rich beef broth and naturally lactose-free melted Gruyère (~0g lactose) on soaked bread are soothing, but stringy caramelized whole onions can catch on inflamed tissue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Only order on steady/good days: eat the broth-soaked bread crouton, melted Gruyère cheese, and savory beef broth while pushing the stringy caramelized onion strands to the side of the crock.
flareEmergencySwap: Order the Potage Parmentier (pureed leek & potato soup) instead for a 9.5/10 liquid-smooth bowl.
watchOuts: Stringy caramelized whole onions (high fructan + mechanical strands)
